what: Design-tool selection box: hovering a layer in the board adds a dashed outline and a name tag. Pressing adds an accent border, eight handles (.35s back.out(2), popping out at .02 stagger), a size tag in real px and four guide lines across the screen. Pressing another layer moves the box from its previous spot in .45s expo.out, and the size tag updates when the window width changes. Esc or pressing empty space releases it

options.fly: Duration of the box moving to another layer (sec), default .45
options.pop: Length (seconds) the handle pops out when first attached, default .35 · .02 between handles
options.auto: This many seconds after the panel attaches, it picks the layer with data-selected by itself (only on screens with interaction), default off
options.guides: Set to 0 to turn off the four guide lines, default 1
options.[data-fx-part=layer]: Selectable layers (children) — label text is their data-label
options.fx:select: Event the board fires on each pick — detail is the picked layer (null when released)
